chunks: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar from Safwan from Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hajjaj said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about the completion (of Hajj) in Mecca and Medina. He said, 'Complete it, even if you do not pray in them except one prayer.'
ai.seo_question: Does omitting the specific Hajj prayers in Meka invalidate the Hajj?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies that the validity of Hajj is not contingent upon performing multiple prayers within the sacred precincts of Mecca and Medina, but rather that even a single prayer suffices for completeness. This ruling underscores the Shia jurisprudential principle that the core obligations of Hajj are distinct from recommended acts, ensuring that pilgrims are not burdened by the omission of supererogatory prayers. It highlights the flexibility in ritual practice, emphasizing that the essential condition is the performance of at least one prayer in the holy sites rather than a specific quantity.
